title: Small Cakes, More Parties
paras: A small cake shop on Pine Street has a surprising new job. It makes tiny [[birthday|birthday]] cakes. Last May, it sold four a week. This May, it sells thirty a week. The shop is [[near|near]] a [[college|college]], but its new buyers are not all young people. Many are [[parent|parents]] with small children. They want a little party, not a big one.

The shop is [[famous|famous]] across the city for its large chocolate cakes. Now, its most popular cake has [[carrot|carrots]] in it. Baker Mina puts [[butter|butter]], eggs, and sugar in a bowl. Then she adds the orange vegetable. Each cake is [[just|just]] ten centimetres wide. Four people can [[eat|eat]] one after dinner. It costs less than a large cake, and there is no food left the next day.

Mina used to [[close|close]] the shop at five. Now she stays until seven because people come after work. On Friday, Omar bought a tiny cake for his mother's seventieth birthday. He put it in his bicycle basket. 'She does not want a big party,' he said. 'But we can still have a sweet evening together.'
zh: 松树街上的一家小蛋糕店有了一项令人意外的新业务：制作迷你生日蛋糕。去年五月，店里每周卖出四个。今年五月，每周能卖出三十个。店铺在一所学院附近，但新顾客并不都是年轻人。许多顾客是家有小孩的父母。他们想办一场小聚会，而不是大聚会。
这家店的大巧克力蛋糕在全城都很有名。如今，店里最受欢迎的蛋糕却含有胡萝卜。蛋糕师米娜把黄油、鸡蛋和糖放进碗里，然后加入这种橙色蔬菜。每个蛋糕只有十厘米宽。四个人可以在晚饭后一起吃一个。它比大蛋糕便宜，而且不会有食物留到第二天。
米娜过去五点关店。现在她一直营业到七点，因为人们会在下班后过来。星期五，奥马尔为母亲的七十岁生日买了一个迷你蛋糕。他把蛋糕放进自行车车篮里。他说：“她不想办大聚会，但我们仍然可以一起度过一个甜蜜的夜晚。”

q.s: This May, the shop sells thirty tiny cakes a week.
q.why: 正文说今年五月每周卖三十个。

q.s: The shop's large chocolate cakes are still its most popular cakes.
q.why: 现在最受欢迎的是胡萝卜蛋糕。

q.s: Omar's mother lives on the same street as the cake shop.
q.why: 文章没有说明奥马尔母亲住在哪里。
